CONF1.question: A detuned two-mirror optical resonator at 1064 nm must have a half-linewidth of about 39 Hz, and the separation of its mirrors cannot exceed 8 m. Its total round-trip loss (excluding the input-mirror transmission) is between 10 and 30 ppm. At sideband frequencies near resonance, light reflected from it must lose less than 30% of its power to the resonator's internal losses. Can such a resonator meet this condition? End your answer with one line: VERDICT: YES or VERDICT: NO.
